project_name: MikiLab Pro - B2B Enterprise Operating System for Bakeries & Pastry Shops
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / ENTERPRISE SAAS ELEGANCE

design_philosophy.core_directive: Transition from dark neon industrial/holographic theme to a crisp, refined, light enterprise look. Elimination of dark gradients, glowing borders, saturated rainbow badges, and emoji headers in favor of clear typography, subtle slate borders, monochrome Lucide icons, and calm warm-accented light surfaces.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Professional, calm, trustworthy, precise, and executive. Built for bakery/pastry floor operations and owner decision-making.
anti_patterns_banned: No dark backgrounds (#0A0F1D, #050505, #111827) on main panels or containers
No loud neon orange (#FF6B00), electric cyan (#00F2FE), or magenta glows
No heavy drop shadows or glowing border animations (box-shadow neon ring)
No emoji characters as panel icons or structural badges in section headers
No transparent dropdown/modal backgrounds without blur or solid slate background

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors data-testid='button-primary'
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors data-testid='button-secondary'
buttons.accent: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-colors data-testid='button-accent'
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors data-testid='button-ghost'

tabs_and_pills.container: bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/60 inline-flex gap-1
tabs_and_pills.active_tab: bg-white text-slate-900 font-medium shadow-sm rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition-all
tabs_and_pills.inactive_tab: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

inputs_and_selects.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 focus:border-blue-600 transition-all
inputs_and_selects.dropdown_menu: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-lg rounded-xl p-1 z-50 min-w-[160px]

header_nav.background: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-40

command_deck_hero.background: bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-md border border-slate-800 relative overflow-hidden
command_deck_hero.accent_pill: bg-white/10 text-slate-200 border border-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

command_deck_hero.description: Artisan baker in professional production environment
Freshly baked artisan sourdough loaves on rustic shelf

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply light mode CSS variables to index.css and App.css as default :root styles.
Replace dark Tailwind classes (bg-slate-900, bg-gray-900, bg-[#0A0F1D], text-white on main containers) with light theme equivalents (bg-slate-50, bg-white, text-slate-900, border-slate-200).
Replace emoji icons in section headers with monochrome Lucide icons (e.g. lucide-react LayoutDashboard, Utensils, Users, Wrench, ShieldCheck, ShoppingBag).
Ensure all buttons, cards, selects, tabs, and input fields include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Remove glowing border effects (glow-orange, glow-teal, box-shadow animations) and replace with clean 1px solid slate-200 borders.
Keep semantic colors reserved strictly for status badges (success/warning/danger/info) using the light background tint variants.
